prompts: Use case: style-transfer. Combine the two reference photos of the SAME FISI basement into ONE coherent wide side-on 16-bit arcade fighting stage named Sótano FISI. Preserve recognizable details: pale cream yellow walls with gray lavender structural columns and beams, dark high transom windows, brown small square tiled floor, open classroom doors at far left and right, two discarded white air conditioner units against back wall, red fire extinguisher and wall first-aid box, staircase rising on left with gray metal handrail and large concrete support, recessed shadowy green corridor beneath stairs to right-center, wooden chairs and electrical cabinet tucked along far right wall. Compose as believable SINGLE wide basement corridor, architecture and props in back 70%, broad continuous flat brown tiled arena floor in front 30% with straight horizontal baseline, no obstacles in foreground. Crisp detailed square pixel clusters, colored dark outlines and dithered shadows, nostalgic 1990s 16-bit arcade background quality. Dim warm institutional lighting with cool gray shadows, no photographic textures or blur, no playable fighters, no HUD, no borders. Widescreen16:9.

Use case: identity-preserve. Reference is the EXACT existing El Fiel 16-bit fighting sprite. Preserve EXACT face identity, black swept/quiff short hair, no beard, athletic muscular proportions, purple short sleeved polo with light collar/arm piping, black athletic shorts, dark purple navy trainers. New production sprite sheet, 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 separate equal cells, generous gaps, every full-body sprite entirely within its cell, all face RIGHT, same head size/pixel density across ALL cells. Flat PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background, absolutely NO purple/magenta color substitution on clothing, polo must be opaque actual purple. No labels/text. FIRST TWO ROWS: eight sequential NON-GRAPHIC OVERHEAD KNIFE ATTACK frames: 1 guard hand reaches waistband, 2 draws small silver knife in right hand, 3 raises knife beside shoulder, 4 winds up above shoulder, 5 makes quick descending diagonal slash forward-right, 6 follows through arm extended diagonally down, 7 returns/retracts knife, 8 holsters and returns to guard. Small knife, no blood, no injuries, no other person, controlled arcade move. LAST TWO ROWS: eight sequential ENERGY PALM SPECIAL frames while ALWAYS keeping purple polo on: 1 guard settles, 2 draws right palm to hip, 3 both hands gather small cyan glow, 4 pushes palms forward at chest height, 5 full extension releasing cyan sparks, 6 retracts arms, 7 settles feet, 8 original guard. No large energy projectile painted in sheet, only tiny cyan palm sparks; game draws projectile. Crisp actual square pixel art matching reference, dark colored outlines and three-tone cel shading, no blur, no photo/3D style, no redesign of face/clothing/body, no cropped feet/hands.

Use case: identity-preserve. Production 16-bit pixel-art animation sheet of the EXACT El Fiel from reference1, using reference2 ONLY for the established shirt-waving move. Preserve reference1's recognizable face, swept black quiff hair, athletic muscular body (not a bodybuilder), black shorts, navy/purple running sneakers, same head and anatomy across every pose, opaque purple polo when worn. Strict 4 columns x 3 rows: TWELVE equal separate cells, full bodies each fit with wide empty gaps, all face RIGHT. Flat pure MAGENTA #FF00FF background for chroma key, no gradient, no shadows, no lettering. ROW1 four consecutive TAKE OFF POLO frames: 1 both hands grip lower hem, 2 lifts hem exposing abdomen with head/face unchanged, 3 lifts over head (arms up, face briefly partially covered), 4 pulls fully off to right hand, bare torso, same face. ROW2 four consecutive WAVE SHIRT TO FIRE ENERGY frames, always bare torso and holding purple polo: 1 raises shirt behind right shoulder, 2 swings cloth forward at chest height, 3 full forward swing with cloth trailing to right, 4 winds cloth back above right shoulder. Tiny cyan sparks only at cloth edge, no big projectile. ROW3 four consecutive PUT SHIRT BACK ON frames: 1 gathers purple polo above head, 2 puts head through collar with polo at chest, 3 pushes arms into sleeves and pulls hem down, 4 original fully clothed fighting guard. Preserve exact face/hair identity from reference1 in shirtless poses, do NOT switch faces to reference2's less accurate man. Same skin palette, no facial/body redesign. Crisp square pixels, original dark outline and 16-bit shading, no blur or painted/3D style, consistent head size and feet baseline throughout all twelve cells.
lanchaFix: Reextracción de la lámina anterior con clave magenta estricta: preservar los píxeles morados del polo, sin rediseño.
